'''Truká '''is an [[extinct language|extinct]] and unattested, but presumed, language of [[Brazil]]. The ethnic population is about 3,200.

It was originally spoken in the [[:pt:Ilha da Assunção|Ilha da Assunção]] archipelago of the [[São Francisco River]] in [[Cabrobó]], [[Pernambuco]] State.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://pib.socioambiental.org/pt/Povo:Truk%C3%A1 |title=Truká |website=Povos Indígenas no Brasil |language=pt |accessdate=29 January 2020}}</ref>
